description: Rules for how topics carry temporal anchoring and concept/instance kind. These fields live on the `topics` table; this vocab governs their semantics.

topic_kind.description: Each topic is either a CONCEPT (an abstract category) or an INSTANCE (a specific occurrence/case). Mirrors entity_kind on entities.

concept.description: Abstract category that can have instances. e.g. 'UFO Crash Retrieval', 'Election Cycle', 'Pandemic'. Its members are unions of its instances' members.
concept.membership_rule_pattern: Usually predicate_walk or co_occurrence over the union of its instance topics.

instance.description: Specific case anchored in time/space. e.g. 'Roswell Incident 1947', '2020 US Presidential Election', 'COVID-19 Pandemic'. Its members are scoped to a concrete event-cluster.
instance.membership_rule_pattern: Usually co_occurrence over a library, signal_cluster, or temporal slice.

topic_kind.concept_topic_id_field: When topic_kind=instance, concept_topic_id points at the parent concept topic. The substrate enforces that instance members are a subset of concept's reachable members.

temporal_anchoring.description: Every topic CAN have a temporal_span. Some topics are timeless (concepts often are); others are tightly bounded (most instances).

fields.temporal_span: PostgreSQL tstzrange. Lower bound inclusive, upper bound exclusive. Open-ended on either side is valid (a topic that's still active has upper=infinity).
fields.temporal_anchor: How the span was determined: 'event' (from member events), 'source' (from source dates), 'inferred' (LLM-derived), 'manual' (user-set).

inheritance_rules: Instance topic's temporal_span must be within or overlap its concept's span.
broader_than relations imply the broader topic's span CONTAINS the narrower's span.
follows / precedes relations are auto-derivable from temporal_span.

rules: An instance's direct members (per its membership_rule) are the canonical 'about-this-instance' set.
Its concept inherits the union of all its instances' members (read-time computation; not materialized).
Members of an instance are NOT automatically members of peer instances — peers share a CONCEPT, not members.

validation_against_gdu.description: How topics are admitted and validated.
rules: Topics go through gateway.admit_node(category='topic', subtype=<nodevocab.topic subtype>).
membership_rule must validate against core.topics.rules.validate() before admission.
temporal_span must use values from valuevocab.time chain when expressed as boundaries.
concept_topic_id (when present) must reference an admitted concept topic in the same tenant.
